description_en: Sets whether the certificate feature is enabled for a specified domain name and updates the certificate information
description_zh: 调用本接口用于设置某域名下证书功能是否启用及更新证书信息
kebab_example: aliyun vod set-vod-domain-ssl-certificate --domain-name example.com --ssl-protocol off --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetVodDomainSSLCertificate

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

upload: an uploaded certificate.
cas: a certificate from SSL Certificates Service
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。

upload：上传证书。
cas：证书中心证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the HTTPS certificate. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。取值：

on：启用。
off：不启用
parameters.name: ssl_protocol

parameters.help_en: The content of the security certificate. If you do not enable the certificate, you do not need to specify this parameter. If you configure a certificate, enter the certificate content
parameters.help_zh: 安全证书内容。不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en: The content of the private key. If you do not enable the certificate, you do not need to specify this parameter. If you configure a certificate, enter the private key content
parameters.help_zh: 私钥内容。不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容
parameters.name: ssl_pri

parameters.help_en:
The certificate region. Valid values:
ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
cn-hangzhou (Hangzhou)

Default value: cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh:
证书Region。取值：
ap-southeast-1（新加坡）
cn-hangzhou（杭州）

默认值为cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: cert_region

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to distribute the certificate in a canary release environment. Valid values:

staging: distributes the certificate in a canary release environment.

If this parameter is not specified or set to any other value, the certificate is formally distributed
parameters.help_zh:
是否灰度下发证书。
取值：staging：灰度下发证书。
不传或者传任何其他值，都是正式下发证书
parameters.name: env
